thread:
maya: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Horizon next Tue. Saw a big spike in embedding calls during their onboarding last week, want to lock down spend forecast + mitigation before the readout.

leo: Got it. Do we have MTD vs forecast numbers? Any sudden config changes on their side?

anita: MTD spend: $28.1k. Projection w/current cadence -> $74.8k by month-end (est based on daily avg). Embedding ops are ~64% of token burn. No infra change flagged on our side.

zack: They turned on batched embeddings (batch size 16) + increased concurrency from 4->10 during product demo. That explains the delta.

nina: They also started using streaming for some chat flows, which increases token count + requests. Might be demo traffic but still risk for renewal.

maya: Can we set a short-term throttle/guardrail and a budget alert for them? Need a clear ask for QBR: either retainer or commit, or we demo async embeddings cache to cut cost.

anita: Suggested options: (1) 30% committed monthly retainer to cap unit cost, (2) enable KV-prefix caching + smaller batch size for onboarding flows, (3) threshold alert at 70% of monthly commit.

finops-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: Account Horizon exceeded weekly forecast by 42%. Current run rate projects over budget. See /alerts/3357700011

leo: For QBR slide: can someone paste a quick spend forecast table and expected delta if we enable prefix caching? I can build the slide.

anita: Quick delta estimate: caching (prefix hits ~45%) -> token burn down ~35% -> projected month-end spend -> ~$49k. If commit 30% retainer -> unit price cut ~18% -> effective spend ~$40k.

maya: Nice. Can you paste the numbers as a snippet I can drop into the deck?

anita: ```
Horizon - Spend scenarios (est)
MTD spend: $28,100
Run rate proj (no change): $74,800
With prefix cache (45% hit): $49,000
With 30% retainer + cache: $40,200
Top drivers: embeddings (64%), demo concurrency spike
```

zack: For the short-term guardrail we can apply a per-route throttle: `max_concurrency: 6`, `burst: 20`, `rate_limit_per_min: 120` for the embeddings route. Should be low-friction.

nina: I'll coordinate enablement session w/CS playbook: 30-min ops walkthrough + caching howto + best-practice prompts. Available Wed/Thu.

leo: Also recommend adding a budget alert rule that tags the account and auto-creates a CS ticket when spend > 60% of expected commit. Quick rule: `if forecasted_month_end > commit_threshold -> create_ticket("cs","finance")`.

maya: That ticket workflow would be great. For QBR we should present two asks: 1) short-term throttle + enablement to stabilize run rate, 2) commit recommendation with clear savings scenario.

anita: I'll draft the ask language and required commit numbers. Can someone own follow-up with the account?

maya: I'll own the follow-up and schedule the enablement. @nina pls send invite and include the caching guide.

nina: On it. Sending invites now.

finops-bot: NOTE: Created ticket CS-10092 for Horizon spend review (linked to alert 3357700011).

leo: For the QBR slide deck I'll add the short-term action checklist and two forecast charts (no-change vs cache+commit). Drop the final numbers here once anita sends the ask language.

anita: Draft ask posted: https://redwood.internal/qbr/horizon/draft-ask — TL;DR: 30% monthly retainer to reduce per-unit price + enable prefix caching. Estimated savings 46% vs current run rate.

maya: Perfect. Action items:
- maya: follow up + present at QBR (owner)
- nina: schedule enablement + invite (Wed/Thu)
- anita: finalize ask language and commit tiers
- leo: finalize deck + charts
- zack: implement short-term per-route throttle and test

maya: Thanks team — aim to close prior to QBR so we have an ask not just a problem. :thumbsup:
